an10.26:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā Mahākaccāno Avantīsu viharati Kuraraghare pavatte pabbate.
an10.26:1.2: Atha kho Kālī upāsikā Kuraragharikā yenāyasmā Mahākaccāno ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Mahākaccānaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho Kālī upāsikā Kuraragharikā āyasmantaṃ Mahākaccānaṃ etad avoca:-- 2.
an10.26:1.3: Vuttam idaṃ bhante Bhagavatā Kumāripañhesu (Cf. S. I, p. 126):
an10.26:2.5: sakkhī na sampajjati kenaci me ti.
an10.26:3.1: Imassa nu kho bhante Bhagavatā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa kathaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabbo ti? 3.
an10.26:4.1: Paṭhavīkasiṇasamāpattiparamā kho bhagini eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā atthābhinibbattesuṃ.
an10.26:4.2: Yāvatā kho bhagini paṭhavīkasiṇasamāpattiparamatā tad abhiññāsi Bhagavā,
an10.26:4.3: tad abhiññāya Bhagavā ādim addasa ādīnavam addasa nissaraṇam addasa maggāmaggañāṇadassanam addasa.
an10.26:4.4: Tassa ādidassanahetu ādīnavadassanahetu nissaraṇadassanahetu maggāmaggañāṇadassanahetu atthassa patti hadayassa santi viditā hoti.
an10.26:5.9: viññāṇakasiṇasamāpattiparamā kho bhagini eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā atthābhinibbattesuṃ.
an10.26:5.10: Yāvatā kho bhagini viññāṇakasiṇasamāpattiparamatā tad abhiññāsi Bhagavā,
an10.26:5.11: tad abhiññāya Bhagavā ādim addasa ādīnavam addasa nissaraṇam addasa maggāmaggañāṇadassanam addasa.
an10.26:5.12: Tassa ādidassanahetu ādīnavadassanahetu nissaraṇadassanahetu maggāmaggañāṇadassanahetu atthassa patti hadayassa santi viditā hoti.
an10.26:5.13: Iti kho bhagini yan taṃ vuttaṃ Bhagavatā Kumāripañhesu
an10.26:6.5: sakkhī na sampajjati kenaci me ti
an10.26:7.1: imassa kho bhagini Bhagavatā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabbo
